Reference / http/redirect

http/redirect#

Following redirects (RFC 9110 §15.4).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let client = HttpClient(redirects: Redirects(limit: 5));
let reply = await client.get("http://example.com/old");
reply::Exchange::history;                    // the hops

Description#

Following redirects (RFC 9110 §15.4).

301, 302, 303, 307 and 308 are followed, up to the limit (0 follows none). 303, and 301 or 302 after POST, become a GET without a body; the others resend the body, which must be replayable. Authorization, Cookie and Proxy-Authorization are dropped when the origin changes, and https never goes to http unless allowed.

object Redirects

Errors#

  • TooManyRedirects: more hops than the limit, or 20 in all.
  • RedirectLoop: a URL came back.
  • NonReplayableRedirect: the body cannot be sent again.
  • UnsafeRedirect: a Location that may not be followed.
